The HNK HGG-1000 is a CNC gear grinding machine for gears up to Ø1,000 mm (39.4 in) outside diameter, the smallest of the four large HGG models. HNK describes the series as a profile grinding type and thread wheel grinding type machine, covering modules M1-M35 at helix angles of ±45°.

Doubling the gear diameter without changing the wheel: that is the HNK HGG-2000. It grinds gears up to Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) outside diameter with exactly the wheel package of the HGG-1000 , and it extends the vertical working range to 1,000 mm (39.4 in).

The HNK HGG-260 is a CNC gear grinding machine for automobile parts, as HNK's one-line description puts it. It grinds gears up to Ø260 mm (10.2 in) outside diameter in modules M0.5-M5, with helix angles of ±45° and a vertical working range of 180 mm (7.1 in).

The HNK HGG-4000 is where the HGG gear grinders change wheel. For gears up to Ø4,000 mm (157.5 in) outside diameter, the module range widens to M1-M50, the maximum wheel diameter rises to 450 mm (17.7 in) and the maximum wheel thickness to 130 mm (5.1 in).

Between car gears and industrial gears sits the HNK HGG-550. HNK files this CNC gear grinding machine under automobile parts, and its range runs to gears of Ø550 mm (21.7 in) outside diameter in modules M0.8-M10: truck and bus transmission gears, axle ring gears, and the larger wheels in construction-machine drivelines.

Gears up to Ø6,000 mm (236.2 in) outside diameter can be ground on the HNK HGG-6000, the largest gear grinding machine in HNK's range. Apart from that diameter, its published specification is the same as the HGG-4000 row for row.

The HNK HGH-2 is a compact 6-axis CNC gear hobbing machine for automobile parts. It takes workpieces up to Ø200 mm (7.9 in) and 50 kg (110 lb), cuts up to module M5, and runs its hob at up to 1,500 rpm.

The HNK HGH-20 is a CNC gear hobbing machine for gears up to Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in), with a Ø1,500 mm (59.1 in) table rated for 15,000 kg (33,069 lb). It opens a series that HNK aims at one job in particular: the yaw and pitch bearings of wind turbines.

The HNK HGH-40 hobs gears up to Ø4,000 mm (157.5 in) on a Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) table. Its maximum gear diameter is twice the table diameter, the same ratio as on the HGH-60 and HGH-80 , so the outer part of a full-size ring sits on arms or a fixture plate beyond the table edge.

With a BT50 hob arbor and an 18.5 kW (24.8 hp) hob spindle, the HNK HGH-5 is the heavier of HNK's two gear hobbing machines for automobile parts. It cuts gears up to Ø500 mm (19.7 in) and module M12 on workpieces of up to 80 kg (176 lb).

100,000 kg (220,459 lb) of table capacity sets the HNK HGH-60 apart from the HGH-40 more than its gear diameter does. This CNC gear hobbing machine cuts gears up to Ø6,000 mm (236.2 in) on a Ø3,000 mm (118.1 in) table, and its load rating is more than three times the 30,000 kg (66,138 lb) of the HGH-40.

The HNK HGH-80 is the largest gear hobbing machine HNK lists and the only one in the series with a bigger motor. Its external cutter head is driven by 70 kW (93.9 hp), and it hobs up to 40M, with 50M in the form milling row. Maximum gear diameter is Ø8,000 mm (315.0 in).

The JTEKT GS200H is a gear skiving center built on a horizontal machining center: one machine that turns, mills, drills, bores and skives gear teeth in a single setup. Description: The Bourn & Koch 1000VBG is a 4-axis CNC vertical grinder for ID and OD work, with a 1,000 mm (39.4 in) table and 1,100 mm (43.3 in) of maximum swing. It is the vertical grinder of the maker's VBX modular platform, designed around a common base, crossrail and column, and Bourn & Koch says it is based on the engineering of Springfield vertical grinders.

The Bourn & Koch Blanchard 22AD-42 is a vertical-spindle rotary surface grinder with a 42 in (1,067 mm) magnetic chuck, a 22 in (559 mm) grinding wheel and 48 in (1,219 mm) of maximum swing. Bourn & Koch redesigned and re-engineered this model in 2018, and the result differs from the larger machines in the line: direct drive on both the chuck and the grinding spindle, hardened and ground linear rails, and a full stainless steel enclosure.

With a 60 in (1,524 mm) magnetic chuck and 72 in (1,829 mm) of maximum swing, the Bourn & Koch Blanchard 32HAD-60 sits in the middle of the Blanchard rotary surface grinder line. The grinding wheel is 32 in (813 mm) in diameter, the standard motor is 100 hp (74.6 kW), and X-axis travel is 24 in (610 mm).

The Bourn & Koch Blanchard 54HAD-100 grinds parts up to 126 in (3,200 mm) across on a 100 in (2,540 mm) one-piece steel magnetic chuck. This is a machine for very large plates and rings. Weight capacity is 30,000 lb (13,608 kg), and the grinder itself weighs approximately 103,000 lb (46,721 kg), so the foundation is part of the project.

The Bourn & Koch Blanchard 72HAD-120 is the largest rotary surface grinder in the line: a 120 in (3,048 mm) single piece steel magnetic chuck under a 72 in (1,829 mm) grinding wheel, with 144 in (3,658 mm) of maximum swing as standard and 164 in (4,166 mm) as an option.

The Bourn & Koch MT³ is a CNC vertical grinder that can also mill, drill, tap and turn. The name is short for moving table modular technology machine tool. Its standard table is 42.00 in (1,066.8 mm) in diameter, maximum swing is 49.00 in (1,244.6 mm), and the workpiece can weigh up to 4,400 lb (2,000 kg).
CNC Control: Fanuc CNC control (model dependent on options chosen)

CNC Control: Fanuc 32; up to 4 axis simultaneous contouring

Description: The Campbell Grinder 1000L1000 is the larger of the two 1000LEAN vertical grinders, with a maximum swing of 1,000 mm (39.37 in) and 1,100 mm (43.5 in) of X travel. Part and fixture can be 865 mm (34.00 in) tall and weigh 910 kg (2,000 lbs).

Description: The Campbell Grinder 1000L800 is the smaller version of the 1000LEAN, a CNC vertical grinder that Campbell builds in a standard size for job shops instead of engineering it to order. It grinds cylindrical parts up to 750 mm (29.5 in) in diameter and 865 mm (34.00 in) tall, with part and fixture weighing up to 910 kg (2,000 lbs).

Description: The Campbell Grinder 750D1000 is a CNC vertical ID/OD grinder for cylindrical parts, with a swing diameter of 1,100 mm (43.3 in) and a part height of 550 mm (21.7 in). Campbell builds the 750 series specifically for this kind of part and names bearings, aerospace and power generation as the industries where the design has been successful.

The Campbell Grinder 800A1000 is the largest 800 series CNC creep feed grinder, with a table of 1,000 x 600 mm (39.4 x 23.6 in). Part height is 500 mm (19.7 in), the spindle speed range is 0 - 5,000 RPM and the axes are X, Y and Z.

Description: The Campbell Grinder 800A400 is the smallest of Campbell's 800 series CNC creep feed grinders, with a 400 x 300 mm (15.7 x 11.8 in) table, a part height of 400 mm (15.7 in) and a grinding spindle that runs from 0 to 3,600 RPM. It has three linear axes, X, Y and Z.

Description: The Campbell Grinder 800A600 is a three-axis CNC creep feed grinder with a 600 x 350 mm (23.6 x 13.8 in) table and room for parts 500 mm (19.7 in) high. Its spindle speed range is 0 - 3,600 RPM.

Description: The Campbell Grinder 800A750 is a CNC creep feed grinder with a 750 x 450 mm (29.5 x 17.7 in) table, 500 mm (19.7 in) of part height and a spindle that runs from 0 to 5,000 RPM. It is the smaller of the two 800 series models with the faster spindle.
Spindle Power Option: up to 100 HP (74.6 kW) and various RPM options (optional)

Description: The Campbell Grinder 930E1000 tops the 930 series: a 5-axis CNC vertical creep feed grinder with a 1,000 mm (39.4 in) table and a spindle listed at up to 100 HP (74.6 kW). Part height is 750 mm (29.5 in).

Description: The Campbell Grinder 930E500 is a 5-axis CNC vertical creep feed grinder with a 500 mm (19.7 in) table and 500 mm (19.7 in) of part height. Campbell describes the 930 as well suited to turbine engine vanes, buckets, shrouds, hangers and panels.
CNC Control: Fanuc 31i; up to 5 axis simultaneous contouring

Description: The Campbell Grinder 930E750 is a 5-axis CNC vertical creep feed grinder with a 750 mm (29.5 in) table and a part height of 750 mm (29.5 in). It is the largest 930 model whose spindle is listed at up to 60 HP (44.7 kW).

Description: The Campbell Grinder CRG4000 is a heavy-duty CNC horizontal cylindrical OD grinder for long, heavy shafts: parts up to 1,000 mm (40 in) in diameter, grind lengths up to 5,080 mm (200 in) and part weights of 4,530 kg (10,000 lbs).

The Chevalier FGC5X-600 is a five-axis CNC grinding center: a machine built like a trunnion machining center that carries grinding wheels in a tool changer. It grinds surfaces and profiles on a workpiece up to Ø24.0 in x H13.8 in (Ø610 x H350 mm) and can reach five sides of it in one clamping.
Max Workpiece Dimensions: Ø24.0 in x H13.8 in (Ø610 x H350 mm)
Wheel Size: Ø6 in x 0.98 in x Ø1.25 in (Ø150 x 25 x Ø31.75 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FMG-B1224 is a traveling column CNC surface and profile grinder with a 24.0 in (610 mm) by 12.0 in (305 mm) grinding area. On this design the column carries the wheelhead across the work, so the table only moves lengthwise and its 11.8 in x 23.6 in (300 x 600 mm) surface stays supported under the wheel at every cross position.
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FMG-B1640 puts a 40 hp (30 kW) spindle on a traveling column grinder with a 39.8 in (1,010 mm) by 15.9 in (405 mm) grinding area. That motor is the point of the machine. Its smaller sibling, the FMG-B1224, has 15 hp (11 kW) behind the same Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in wheel, so the step up is in how hard the wheel can be pushed as much as in table size.
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FRG-400S is the smallest of Chevalier's rotary surface grinders: a Ø15.7 in (Ø400 mm) turntable under a horizontal wheel spindle, run by the SMART iControl. The part spins at 10 to 150 rpm while the wheel feeds across it, so a round face is ground in one continuous pass with no table reversals.
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 1.5 in x Ø5 (Ø355 x 38 x Ø127 mm)

Description: A Ø23.6 in (Ø600 mm) hydrostatic turntable and a maximum grinding radius of R12.8 in (R325 mm) define the Chevalier FRG-600S, the mid-size model of the FRG rotary surface grinders. The radius is larger than half the table, so the wheel can run slightly past the table edge and finish a part that covers the whole chuck.
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 1.5 in x Ø5 (Ø355 x 38 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FRG-800S starts the larger frame of the FRG rotary surface grinders. Its Ø31.5 in (Ø800 mm) hydrostatic turntable carries 2,204 lb (1,000 kg), and nearly everything around the table is heavier than on the two small models: a 15 hp (11 kW) spindle, a wider wheel and a machine weight of 14,100 lb (6,400 kg).
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FRG-1000S is the largest rotary surface grinder Chevalier lists, with a hydrostatic turntable of Ø39.4 in (Ø1000 mm) and a table load of 2,644 lb (1,200 kg). Maximum grinding radius is R20.7 in (R525 mm).
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FSG-B818CNCII is a three-axis CNC surface grinder with an 18 in (457 mm) by 8 in (203 mm) grinding area, run from a FANUC control. It is the small machine in Chevalier's FANUC-controlled surface grinder pair, built for profile and form work on toolroom-sized parts and not for covering a large chuck.
Wheel Size: Ø12 in x 1.25 in x Ø3 in (Ø305 x 31.75 x Ø76.2 mm)

Description: The Chevalier FSG-C1224CNCII is a heavy CNC surface grinder: a 24 in (610 mm) by 12 in (305 mm) grinding area under a 30 hp spindle, with 50 hp available as an option. Chevalier sells it as its heavy-duty FANUC-controlled model, and the wheel says why. It is Ø14 in x 4 in x Ø5 in, a 4 in (102 mm) wide wheel on a machine whose whole grinding width is 12 in (305 mm).
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 4 in x Ø5 in (Ø356 x 102 x Ø127 mm)

Description: This model was not found in Chevalier Machinery's current lineup when we checked on 2026-10-03 . It may be a superseded or older model; the specifications below are as we last recorded them.
Surface Finish: Ra 0.1 µm achievable with fine dressing
CNC Control: Chevalier CNC (Smart III) or Fanuc 0i-TF optional

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B818IV is the smallest grinder in the SMART-IV range, with an 18.1 in (460 mm) by 7.9 in (200 mm) grinding area and a spindle that reaches 7,000 rpm. The next size up, the SMART-H/B1224IV, stops at 1,800 rpm, so this is the model built around a small wheel: Ø8 in x 0.5 in x Ø1.3 in, driven by a 4 hp (3 kW) motor across a 1,000 to 7,000 rpm range.
Table Speed: H: 0.33 to 82 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 0.1 to 25 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø8 in x 0.5 in x Ø1.3 in (Ø205 x 12.7 x Ø31.75 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B1224IV is the 24 in (610 mm) by 12 in (305 mm) model of the SMART-IV CNC surface and profile grinders. It is the first size in the range to carry the 15 hp (11 kW) spindle and the Ø14 in x 2 in x Ø5 in wheel, which makes it a general-purpose machine where the smaller SMART-H/B818IV, with 4 hp (3 kW), is a fine-profile one.
Table Speed: H: 16 to 82 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 25 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø355 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B1640IV grinds 40 in (1,015 mm) by 16 in (406 mm), the largest area in the first group of SMART-IV grinders before the range moves to the heavier, wider frames. Long, fairly narrow work is its territory: die shoes, guide rails, wear strips and plates that would overhang a 24 in table.
Table Speed: H: 16 to 82 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 25 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø355 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B2048IV opens the heavy half of the SMART-IV range: a 47.2 in (1,200 mm) by 19.7 in (500 mm) grinding area on a machine that weighs 14,100 lb (6,400 kg). The jump from the 16 in wide SMART-H/B1640IV is bigger than the dimensions suggest, because table load rises from 1,036 lb (470 kg) to 2,755 lb (1,250 kg).
Table Speed: H: 16 to 98.4 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 30 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø355 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B2064IV is the long-table version of the 20 in wide SMART-IV grinder, with a grinding area of 63.0 in (1,600 mm) by 19.7 in (500 mm). It is the SMART-H/B2048IV stretched by roughly a third: the same width, the same 28.7 in (730 mm) under the wheel centerline, the same spindle, and 66.9 in (1,700 mm) of table travel in place of 51.2 in (1,300 mm).
Table Speed: H: 16 to 98.4 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 30 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø14 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø355 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B2448IV is the shortest of the 24 in wide SMART-IV grinders: 47.2 in (1,200 mm) of grinding length by 23.6 in (600 mm) of width. It is the first model in the range on the big frame, and three things change with it. The wheel grows to Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in, the spindle range widens to 500 to 2,200 rpm, and the cross feed speeds up to 0 to 16.4 fpm (0 to 5,000 mm/min).
Table Speed: H: 16 to 98.4 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 30 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B2464IV is the middle length of the 24 in wide SMART-IV grinders, with 63.0 in (1,600 mm) of grinding length and 23.6 in (600 mm) of width. In the range it sits between the 47.2 in SMART-H/B2448IV and the 78.7 in SMART-H/B2480IV, and all three share one cross section: 27.0 in (685 mm) of cross travel and 33.5 in (850 mm) from table to wheel centerline.
Table Speed: H: 16 to 98.4 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 30 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H/B2480IV grinds 78.7 in (2,000 mm) by 23.6 in (600 mm), and it is the longest SMART-IV grinder still offered in both the H and the B version. The two longer machines in the range, the SMART-H24120IV and SMART-H24160IV, are listed as H only. If a job needs the B version's table speed range of 0 to 65.6 fpm, this is where the length stops.
Table Speed: H: 16 to 98.4 fpm / B: 0 to 65.6 fpm (H: 5 to 30 m/min / B: 0 to 20 m/min)
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H24120IV is a three-metre CNC surface and profile grinder: 118.1 in (3,000 mm) of grinding length by 23.6 in (600 mm) of width, with 125.9 in (3,200 mm) of table travel. It is one of two SMART-IV models listed only as an H machine, with a single table speed range of 16 to 98.4 fpm (5 to 30 m/min).
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Chevalier SMART-H24160IV is the largest machine in the SMART-IV range, a four-metre grinder with a 23.6 in x 157.5 in (600 x 4,000 mm) table and 165.4 in (4,200 mm) of travel. Nothing else in the series comes close in length, and few toolroom grinders anywhere are built this long with a conversational profile control.
Wheel Size: Ø16 in x 2 in x Ø5 in (Ø405 x 50 x Ø127 mm)

Description: The Danobat CG-600 is the shortest machine in the CG line of production cylindrical grinders, with 600 mm (23.62 in) between centers and a 440 mm (17 in) maximum ground diameter. Its grinding wheel is larger than the part it is likely to hold: Ø610 x 160 mm (Ø24 x 6.29 in), run at up to 80 m/s (15,750 sfpm).
Mdm Gauge Accuracy: ±1.5 μm accuracy and 1 μm repeatability (MDM in- and post-process gauge)

Description: One metre between centers puts the Danobat CG-1000 in the size most transmission and motor shafts need. It is the middle model of the CG production grinders: 1,000 mm (39.37 in) between centers, 440 mm (17 in) maximum ground diameter and 500 kg (1,100 lb) between centers.
Mdm Gauge Accuracy: ±1.5 μm accuracy and 1 μm repeatability (MDM in- and post-process gauge)

Description: The Danobat CG-1800 stretches the CG production grinder to 1,800 mm (70.9 in) between centers and is the only CG model that grinds up to 540 mm (21 in) in diameter. Weight between centers stays at 500 kg (1,100 lb), so it is a machine for long parts of moderate mass: rotor shafts, ball screws, long spindles.
Mdm Gauge Accuracy: ±1.5 μm accuracy and 1 μm repeatability (MDM in- and post-process gauge)

Description: The Danobat CGX is a universal cylindrical grinder built around a three-wheel head, two for outside diameters and one for bores, on a machine that accepts parts up to 1,800 mm (70.9 in) between centers, 540 mm (21.2 in) in diameter and 500 kg (1,102 lb). Danobat presents it as its versatile, compact model and says it uses 30% less floor space than moving-table alternatives.
B Axis Repeatability: ±1 μm measured at a radius of 650 mm (25.6 in)
Mdm Gauge Accuracy: ±1.5 μm accuracy and 1 μm repeatability (optional MDM gauge)

Description: 500 / 0-1,150* mm (19.6 / 0-45.2* in) (*optional CNC moving gap)

With Ø4,100 mm (Ø161 in) of swing over the gap, the Danobat DANUNI-4100 is the larger of Danobat's two gap bed grinders for landing gear components. It is the size for the largest gear legs, where the leg, its trunnions and its attachment lugs describe a circle more than four metres across when the part turns.
Ø610 / 760 / 915* mm (Ø24 / 30 / 36* in) (*not available with B-axis)
Max Grinding Wheel Diameter: Ø610 / 760 / 915* mm (Ø24 / 30 / 36* in) (*not available with B-axis)

Description: Ø760 / 915 / 1,060* mm (Ø30 / 36 / 40* in) (*not available with B-axis)
Max Grinding Wheel Diameter: Ø760 / 915 / 1,060* mm (Ø30 / 36 / 40* in) (*not available with B-axis)

Description: The Danobat ID-300 is the smallest machine in the Overbeck ID/IED series, an internal and external grinder for chucked parts up to 215 mm (8.46 in) of swing. It grinds bores up to 200 mm (7.87 in) in diameter and 100 mm (3.94 in) deep, and outside diameters up to 215 mm (8.46 in) over a length of 100 mm (3.94 in). Danobat describes the series as designed primarily for ID, OD and face grinding, with non-round, thread, taper and jig grinding available when needed.
Machine Dimensions: 215 x 210 x 220 cm (84.65 x 82.68 x 86.61 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 4 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: With a 560 mm (22.05 in) swing and room for a 500 mm (19.69 in) outside diameter, the Danobat ID-500 is the large-ring member of the Overbeck ID/IED series. Its internal capacity is a 300 mm (11.81 in) bore ground to a depth of 200 mm (7.87 in). External grinding covers 150 mm (5.91 in) of length, so this is a machine for rings, housings and flanged parts whose diameter is larger than their length.
Machine Dimensions: 215 x 275 x 225 cm (84.65 x 108.27 x 88.58 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 4 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: Two turrets working at once define the Danobat IED-500. Where the ID models of the Overbeck ID/IED series grind a bore and then an outside diameter, the IED brings what Danobat calls a dual-turret design for simultaneous ID and OD grinding, and credits it with cutting cycle times by up to 50%. It is the production variant of the family.
Machine Dimensions: 220 x 250 x 255 cm (86.61 x 98.43 x 100.39 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 4 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: The Danobat ILD-600 is the long-part machine of the Overbeck internal grinding range: a universal grinder that takes workpieces up to 1,300 mm (51.18 in) long with their clamping and up to 500 kg (1,102 lb) on the workhead. Swing is 600 mm (23.62 in). Bores up to 420 mm (16.54 in) in diameter can be ground to a depth of 400 mm (15.75 in).
Machine Dimensions: 225 x 400 x 260 cm (88.58 x 157.48 x 102.36 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 4 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: Radius grinding in a small footprint is the brief of the Danobat IRD-300, the entry model of the Overbeck IRD series. Its workhead sits on a B0 axis that swivels +91° / -15°, so a spherical seat, a contoured bore or a steep taper can be generated by swinging the part past the wheel. Danobat calls the IRD the only grinding machine that combines radius grinding with fully integrated non-round capabilities.
Machine Dimensions: 215 x 210 x 220 cm (84.65 x 82.68 x 86.61 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: up to 3 spindles and a measuring probe

Machine Dimensions: 215 x 275 x 225 cm (84.65 x 108.27 x 88.58 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 5 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: At 700 mm (27.56 in) of swing and 500 kg (1,102 lb) on the workhead, the Danobat IRD-700 is the largest radius grinder in the Overbeck IRD series. It is the only IRD model with equal travels in both axes, 700 mm (27.56 in) in X and 700 mm (27.56 in) in Z, and the only one whose external grinding length matches its internal one at 400 mm (15.75 in).
Machine Dimensions: 235 x 400 x 280 cm (92.52 x 157.48 x 110.24 in) (height x width x depth)
Spindle Turret: direct driven, 300° swivelling range, up to 5 spindles and one measuring probe

Description: The Danobat IRDc is a single-purpose machine: an Overbeck grinder set up for regrinding the worn punches and dies of can production. Danobat says it handles every punch, ironing die and redraw die used in canmaking, and covers ID, OD, radius and profile grinding in one compact machine.
Die Grinding Results: Ra < 0.03 μm, runout < 2.5 μm, roundness tighter than 0.5 μm
Punch Grinding Results: major diameters ±2.5 μm, surface finish Ra 0.05 to 0.08 μm
Robotic Cell Capacity: up to 90 dies, shifts of up to 11 hours without operator intervention (optional robotic cell)

Max Grinding Wheel Diameter: Ø760 / 915 / 1,060* mm (Ø30 / 36 / 40* in) (*not available with B-axis)
Ø760 / 915 / 1,060 / 1,250* mm (Ø30 / 36 / 40 / 50* in) (*not available with B-axis)

The Drake GS:CG is a crown grinder, a CNC machine with 7 axes that grinds the drums used in making tapered roller bearings. It takes parts from 100 mm (3.9 in) to 355 mm (14.0 in) in diameter and up to 900 mm (35.4 in) bearing end-to-end, with a maximum grind length of 750 mm (29.5 in) centered on pivot.
Dresser Axes Positioning: Ball Screws and Fanuc Servos (W, Y)

Description: The Drake GS:DS is a dual spindle grinder: one machine with an external grinding spindle and an internal grinding spindle, and 5 CNC axes. Drake's case for it is that several operations are ground in one fixture setup, so threads stay aligned to the other ground datums of the part.

The Drake GS:DS-1000 is the long-bed version of Drake's dual spindle grinder, with 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers. Like the GS:DS it carries an external and an internal grinding spindle and 5 CNC axes, and it weighs 19,000 kg (41,887 lb).

The Drake GS:TE240-330MH is the external machine in Drake's MH pair of thread grinders: 330 mm (13.0 in) between centers, 240 mm (9.4 in) of swing over the table and 3 CNC axes. Drake describes the MH models as manual helix machines, which points to a wheel head that is set to the lead angle by hand while the CNC runs the grinding axes.

The Drake GS:TE240-360 is a CNC external thread grinder with 4 axes, for parts up to 240 mm (9.4 in) in diameter and 360 mm (14.2 in) between centers. It is the smallest GS:TE machine on the range's full-size wheel package: wheels of ≤400 mm (15.7 in) outside diameter on a 160 mm (6.3 in) bore, on a wheel spindle that Drake lists as 12 kW / 16 kW (16.1 hp / 21.5 hp) at 8,000 rpm.
Positioning Accuracy: <0.004 mm (<0.00016 in) over length of travel

Description: The Drake GS:TE400-750 is the mid-size external thread grinder of the GS:TE range, with 750 mm (29.5 in) between centers and 400 mm (15.7 in) of swing over the table. It has 4 CNC axes, an A2-8 workhead spindle nose and a wheel spindle listed as 12 kW / 16 kW (16.1 hp / 21.5 hp) at 8,000 rpm.

The Drake GS:TE400-2000 is the long-bed external thread grinder for screws: 2,100 mm (82.7 in) between centers, for parts up to 400 mm (15.7 in) in diameter. Drake's brochure gives the length as 2,100 mm even though the model name suggests less, so the table is the figure to plan with.
Positioning Accuracy: <0.004 mm (<0.00016 in) over length of travel

Description: The Drake GS:TE445-4000 is the largest external thread grinder Drake lists, with 4,000 mm (157.5 in) between centers and a maximum part diameter of 445 mm (17.5 in). It weighs 32,000 kg (70,547 lb). Everything else about the machine follows from those three figures.
Positioning Accuracy: <0.004 mm (<0.00016 in) over length of travel

Description: The Drake GS:TE670-750 puts the largest swing of the GS:TE external thread grinders on a short bed: 670 mm (26.4 in) over the table with 750 mm (29.5 in) between centers. That shape suits parts that are large in diameter and short, such as thread rolls and rotor components, more than long screws.

The Drake GS:TEM is the smallest machine in Drake's external thread grinder brochure: a CNC grinder with 3 axes for parts up to 25 mm (1.0 in) in diameter, with a 5 kW (6.7 hp) wheel spindle that runs to 12,000 rpm. It weighs 3,000 kg (6,614 lb) and occupies 1.45 m W x 1.85 m D (57.1 in x 72.8 in).
Positioning Accuracy: <0.004 mm (<0.00016 in) over length of travel

Description: The Drake GS:TI240MH is the internal thread grinder of Drake's MH pair: a manual helix machine with 3 CNC axes, 240 mm (9.4 in) of swing over the table and a maximum internal grind length of 190 mm (7.5 in). Internal thread grinding of this kind is mostly ball nut and thread gage work.

The Drake GS:TI280 is the smallest of Drake's 4-axis CNC internal thread grinders, with 280 mm (11.0 in) of swing over the table and a maximum internal grind length of 190 mm (7.5 in). Drake names ball nuts, thread gages and power steering components as the typical work.
The Drake GS:TI400 is the middle machine of Drake's three 4-axis internal thread grinders. Swing over the table is 400 mm (15.7 in), and the maximum internal grind length is 190 mm (7.5 in).

The Drake GS:TI670 is the large-swing internal thread grinder in the GS:TI range: 670 mm (26.4 in) over the table, with 4 CNC axes and a maximum internal grind length of 190 mm (7.5 in). It is for internal threads in parts that are big on the outside, such as large rings and housings.

Description: The EMAG UG 400 is a universal cylindrical grinding machine with 400 mm (16 in) between centers and a 175 mm (7 in) center height. It grinds outside diameters with a 500 x 40 (50ROS) x 203.2 mm (20 x 1.5 (50ROS) x 8 in) wheel on a 7.5 kW (10.1 hp) spindle at a peripheral speed of 60 m/s, and bores with a high-frequency internal spindle that runs from 20,000 - 125,000 1/min and takes 50 mm (2 in) wheels.
Internal Grinding Spindle Mount: 120 mm (5 in) HF spindle mount diameter
Dressing: External: on workpiece head, dressing blades; internal: table swing-arm type

The Glebar CAM.2 is a micro grinder for small, complex parts ground from wire: medical guidewires, needle points, radiuses and non-linear shapes. Incoming stock runs from 0.005 in (0.13 mm) to 0.250 in (6.35 mm) in diameter, and the minimum grind diameter is 0.0005 in (0.013 mm). The part is carried by a patented dual-carriage linear motor feed system, so its position, feed speed and rotation are all commanded.
Work Wheel Speed: Variable up to 3,600 rpm; 11,000 SFPM (56 m/s)
Power Requirement: 380-400 VAC / 460-480 VAC, 3PH, 30 A, 50/60 Hz (Voltage Conversion Kit available for other voltages)

Description: Two 7 in (178 mm) wheels or two 10 in (254 mm) wheels
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.031 in (0.8 mm) – Max 0.500 in (13 mm)
Work Wheel Diameter: Two 7 in (178 mm) wheels or two 10 in (254 mm) wheels
Grinding Diameter Stock: Min 0.031 in (0.8 mm) – Max 0.500 in (13 mm) (application dependent)

Description: The Glebar FW-9D is a ferris wheel style OD grinder: parts are loaded on precision arbors and plunge ground so that the outside form is true to the centre of the part. Glebar says the machine was first designed for rubber capstans and has since moved on to precision bushings and ceramic components such as spark plugs. Part diameter runs from 0.25 in (6.35 mm) to 1.5 in (38 mm), and grinding length is at most 5 in (127 mm).
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.25 in (6.35 mm) – Max 1.5 in (38 mm)

Description: The Glebar GT-9AC is an automated guidewire grinder: a centerless machine with a wire feeder attached, built to grind tapers, paddles and parabolic shapes into medical guidewires from 0.0015 in (0.038 mm) to 0.045 in (1.14 mm) in diameter. Wires up to 16 ft (4.9 m) long can be loaded, and up to 15 ft (4.6 m) of that length ground.
Tooling: 1.5 in (38 mm) and 3 in (76 mm) wide tooling

Description: The Glebar GT-610 is the automated infeed and thrufeed centerless grinder at the middle of the GT-610 family, built on a 6 in (152 mm) thick granite bed around a 10 x 8.625 in (254 x 219 mm) work wheel driven by 15 hp (11 kW). It grinds diameters from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) up to 2.0 in (50.8 mm). Glebar recommends it for infeed jobs that do not need a CNC dresser and for most thrufeed work.
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.002 in (0.05 mm) – Max 2.0 in (50.8 mm)

Description: The Glebar GT-610 CNC is the top model of the GT-610 centerless family: an infeed and thrufeed grinder with a 15 hp (11 kW) work wheel 8.625 in (219 mm) wide, CNC dressing of both wheels, and a part range from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) to 2.0 in (50.8 mm) in diameter. Glebar positions it for lights-out production where gauging feedback and data gathering are part of the job.
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.002 in (0.05 mm) – Max 2.0 in (50.8 mm)

Description: The Glebar GT-610 SD is the member of the GT-610 centerless family set up for superhard materials such as polycrystalline diamond, where the right grinding process is not known in advance. It is an infeed and thrufeed machine with a 15 hp (11.2 kW) work wheel spindle and a wheel 8.625 in (219 mm) long, and it grinds diameters from 0.05 mm to 38.1 mm.

The Glebar PG-9CRG is an OD grinding system that plunges a formed wheel into a part held on its own centerline, in a collet, instead of supporting it centerless. The ground diameter therefore comes out concentric to the shaft. Glebar gives rubber rollers for laser printers and dental drills as the two ends of its range. Grinding length and work wheel length are the same figure, 12.625 in, printed as 32 cm for the grind and 321 mm for the wheel.

The Glebar PG-9DHD is a centerless form grinder that Glebar describes as the high-precision version of its PG-9BHD. It plunge grinds spherical and cylindrical parts from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) to 4 in (100 mm) in diameter against a work wheel 9 in (229 mm) in diameter and 10.125 in (257 mm) long, with a maximum grinding length of 10 in (254 mm). Several parts can be formed in a single infeed motion.
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.002 in (0.05 mm) – Max 4 in (100 mm)

Description: The Glebar PG-9X20DHD is a centerless form grinder stretched to a 20 in (508 mm) work wheel, built for forming long ceramic and carbide blanks while they are still soft. Glebar names unfired carbide and the crystal quartz glass boules used for fibre optics as the target work, ground to near net size. Maximum grinding length is 20 in (508 mm), and part diameter runs from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) to 4 in (100 mm).
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.002 in (0.05 mm) – Max 4 in (100 mm)

Description: The Glebar PG-912DG is an enclosed centerless form grinder with a work wheel 12.625 in (321 mm) wide, wider than the 10.125 in (257 mm) wheel of the PG-9DHD . It plunge grinds spheres and cylindrical forms from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) up to 4 in (102 mm) in diameter, and the extra wheel width is there to fit more parts into each plunge. Glebar reports throughput gains of as much as 30% in its own testing.
Wheel Size: 9 in (229 mm) diameter x 12.625 in (321 mm) wide

Description: The Glebar TF-9D is a compact infeed and thrufeed centerless grinder under computer control, sized for parts from 0.002 in (0.05 mm) to 2.5 in (63.5 mm) in diameter. Its work wheel is 9 in (229 mm) in diameter and 8.625 in (219 mm) wide, and the main spindle is offered at 7.5 hp (5.6 kW), 10 hp (7.5 kW) or 15 hp (11 kW). Glebar lists catheters, guidewires and spinal cord stimulators among its uses: soft polymers and hard metals on one machine.
Grinding Diameter Capacity: Min 0.002 in (0.05 mm) – Max 2.5 in (63.5 mm)
Grinding Length: Infeed 8 in (200 mm), Thrufeed – no limit

It makes complete drills, end mills and similar tools from 1.5 mm (1/16 in) to 32 mm in diameter and up to 300 mm (12 in) long, in one clamping.

Description: The Jainnher JHA-2003CNC is a small CNC angular cylindrical grinder. Its wheel head approaches the work at 60° instead of square on, which lets one wheel grind a diameter and the shoulder beside it in a single infeed. Capacity matches the plunge-type JHP-2003CNC : 200 mm (7.9 in) of swing, 300 mm (11.8 in) between centers and 80 kg (176 lb).

The Jainnher JHA-3505CNC is a CNC angular cylindrical grinder with 350 mm (13.8 in) of swing. Its distance between centers is 600 mm (23.6 in), but the maximum grinding length is 520 mm (20.5 in). The 05 in the name reflects that shorter figure.

The Jainnher JHA-3508CNC is a long-bed CNC angular cylindrical grinder: 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers, 820 mm (32.3 in) of grinding length and 350 mm (13.8 in) of swing. It is the machine in the JHA range for shafts with several shoulders along their length.

The Jainnher JHA-4005CNC is the 400 mm (15.7 in) swing version of Jainnher's shorter CNC angular cylindrical grinder. Grinding length is 520 mm (20.5 in) on a 600 mm (23.6 in) center distance, and the wheel head feeds at 60°.

The Jainnher JHA-4008CNC is the top of Jainnher's CNC angular cylindrical range, combining the 400 mm (15.7 in) swing with the long bed: 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers and an 820 mm (32.3 in) grinding length.

The Jainnher JHC-2408T-CNC6 is a large CNC centerless grinding machine for round work from 2 to 230 mm (0.1 to 9.1 in) in diameter. The grinding wheel is listed as Ø610 x 205 x Ø304.8 (diameter x width x hole), turns at 1,050 rpm and is driven by a 40 HP (29.8 kW) motor.
Wheel Size: Ø610 x 205 x Ø304.8 (dia. x width x hole)
Regulating Wheel Size: Ø305 x 205 x Ø127 (dia. x width x hole)

Description: The Jainnher JHD-1503IO is a CNC double spindle grinding machine: one chucking, two wheels, with the outside diameter ground by a wheel on the Y axis and the bore by a wheel on the Z axis. It is the small model of the JHD line, for parts up to 150 mm (5.9 in) in grinding diameter within a 300 mm (11.8 in) swing.
ID Grinding Capacity: Ø 6 ~ Ø 120 x 80 mm; Ø 2 ~ Ø 6 (opt)

Description: The Jainnher JHD-3205II is the internal-only member of the JHD-3205 double spindle family. Where its siblings pair an external wheel with an internal one, this model carries two internal wheel heads, which Jainnher's table writes as ID, ID.

The Jainnher JHD-3205IO is the external-and-internal model of the larger JHD double spindle grinder. It grinds outside diameters up to 320 mm (12.5 in) over a length of 200 mm (7.9 in), and bores from Ø 6 to Ø 200 up to 150 mm deep, without taking the part out of the 8 in chuck.

The Jainnher JHD-3205IU is the JHD-3205 double spindle grinder set up for serious outside diameter work. Its external wheel is 405 x 50 mm (15.9 x 2.0 in), running at 1,780 rpm. The JHD-3205IO , on the same base, has a 205 x 25 mm (8.1 x 1.0 in) wheel at 3,100 rpm.

The Jainnher JHI-150BCNC is the B-axis version of Jainnher's small CNC internal grinder. It keeps the 6 to 150 mm (0.2 to 5.9 in) bore range and 150 mm (5.9 in) grinding depth of the JHI-150CNC and adds a rotary table that swivels ±15° under program control, in steps of 0.001°.

The Jainnher JHI-150CNC is a compact CNC internal grinding machine for bores from 6 to 150 mm (0.2 to 5.9 in) in diameter and up to 150 mm (5.9 in) deep. Parts up to 200 mm (7.9 in) long are held in a chuck on an A2-5 spindle nose, inside a chuck guard that clears 280 mm (11.0 in).

Description: The Jainnher JHP-2003CNC is the smallest of Jainnher's CNC plunge cylindrical grinders: 200 mm (7.9 in) of swing, 300 mm (11.8 in) between centers and a workpiece limit of 80 kg (176 lb). It is a machine for small shafts, pins and spools ground in volume.

The Jainnher JHP-3506CNC is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with 350 mm (13.8 in) of swing and 600 mm (23.6 in) between centers, for workpieces up to 150 kg (331 lb). It is the first size in the JHP range built on the heavier base, and the jump from the JHP-2003CNC is large: net weight fully enclosed is 7,460 kg (16,446 lb).

The Jainnher JHP-3510CNC stretches Jainnher's 350 mm (13.8 in) swing plunge grinder to 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers. Table travel becomes 1,100 mm (43.3 in), and the fully enclosed machine weighs 8,080 kg (17,813 lb).

The Jainnher JHP-4006CNC is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with a 400 mm (15.7 in) swing over a 600 mm (23.6 in) center distance. In Jainnher's table it stands beside the JHP-3506CNC and differs from it in two rows only: the swing, and a grinding diameter printed as Ø380 where the smaller machine has Ø330.

The Jainnher JHP-4010CNC is the largest CNC plunge cylindrical grinder Jainnher lists: 400 mm (15.7 in) of swing and 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers. It shares its bed and its 8,080 kg (17,813 lb) fully enclosed weight with the JHP-3510CNC and adds swing.

The Jainnher JHU-2706CNC is the smallest of Jainnher's CNC universal cylindrical grinders, with a 270 mm (10.6 in) swing, a 600 mm (23.6 in) grinding length and a 70 kg (154 lb) limit between centers. Maximum grinding diameter is 250 mm (9.8 in).

The Jainnher JHU-2710CNC is a CNC universal cylindrical grinder with a 270 mm (10.6 in) swing and a 1,000 mm (39.4 in) grinding length. It sits one step up from the JHU-2706CNC , and the step is bigger than the extra bed length suggests.

The Jainnher JHU-2715CNC gives Jainnher's 270 mm (10.6 in) swing universal grinder a 1,500 mm (59.1 in) grinding length. It is a machine for long, fairly light shafts: grinding diameter is 250 mm (9.8 in) and the weight limit between centers is 130 kg (287 lb).
The Jainnher JHU-2720CNC is the longest machine in the 270 mm (10.6 in) swing JHU-CNC line: a CNC universal cylindrical grinder with a 2,000 mm (78.7 in) grinding length.
The Jainnher JHU-3506CNC pairs the larger swing of Jainnher's CNC universal grinders, 350 mm (13.8 in), with the shortest bed, 600 mm (23.6 in). Grinding diameter is 330 mm (13.0 in).

The Jainnher JHU-3510CNC is the middle of Jainnher's CNC universal cylindrical range and the size most general shops would start from: 350 mm (13.8 in) of swing, a 330 mm (13.0 in) grinding diameter and 1,000 mm (39.4 in) of grinding length, carrying 130 kg (287 lb) between centers.

The Jainnher JHU-3515CNC is a CNC universal cylindrical grinder for parts up to 1,500 mm (59.1 in) long and 330 mm (13.0 in) in grinding diameter, on a 350 mm (13.8 in) swing. Weight between centers is 130 kg (287 lb).

The Jainnher JHU-3520CNC is the largest CNC universal cylindrical grinder in Jainnher's JHU line. It has the 350 mm (13.8 in) swing and the 2,000 mm (78.7 in) bed together, with a 330 mm (13.0 in) grinding diameter.

Machine Name: Jainnher L100 CNC Cylindrical Roll Grinder

Machine Name: Jainnher M60 CNC Cylindrical Roll Grinder

Machine Name: Jainnher S40 CNC Cylindrical Roll Grinder
Description: The Jainnher S40 is the smallest type in Jainnher's CNC cylindrical roll grinding machine range, for rolls up to 400 mm (15.7 in) in diameter and 1,500 kg (3,307 lb). It is offered with a distance between centers of 1.5, 2, 3 or 4 m (4.9, 6.6, 9.8 or 13.1 ft).

The Palmary FCL-12 is the small machine of the FCL line of CNC centerless grinders, the series Palmary builds with alloy bearing spindles. Its standard grinding range is Ø1 to Ø40 mm, and a special arrangement extends it to Ø30 to Ø60 mm.

The Palmary FCL-18 is the mid-size CNC centerless grinder of the FCL alloy bearing spindle series. It covers Ø1 to Ø60 mm as standard and Ø40 to Ø150 mm with a special arrangement, using a Ø455 mm grinding wheel 205 mm wide.

The Palmary FCL-20 is the largest CNC centerless grinder in the FCL alloy bearing spindle series. It carries a Ø510 mm grinding wheel, 205 mm wide, on a 20 HP (15 kW) motor, and grinds Ø1 to Ø60 mm as standard or Ø40 to Ø150 mm with a special arrangement.

The Palmary FCL-1810 is the wide-wheel version of the FCL-18 CNC centerless grinder. The grinding wheel is Ø455 mm by 255 mm and the regulating wheel Ø255 mm by 255 mm, where the FCL-18 has 205 mm wheels.

The Palmary OCA-3235 is a CNC angular cylindrical grinder: the wheelhead approaches the work at an angle, so a single infeed grinds a diameter and the shoulder next to it. It has Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing, 350 mm (13.8 in) between centers and a maximum grinding diameter of Ø300 mm (11.8 in).

The Palmary OCA-3235H is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder built on Palmary's heavy OCA frame. It has Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing, 350 mm (13.8 in) between centers and grinds to Ø300 mm (11.8 in), with an 11 kW (14.8 hp) wheel motor.

The Palmary OCA-3235H200 carries the widest wheel of any Palmary cylindrical grinder: Ø610 mm in diameter and 200 mm across, on a 203.2 mm bore. It is a CNC plunge grinder with Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing and 350 mm (13.8 in) between centers.

The Palmary OCA-3265 is the 650 mm (25.6 in) model of Palmary's CNC angular cylindrical grinders. Swing over the table is Ø320 mm (12.6 in) and the largest ground diameter Ø300 mm (11.8 in). Like the rest of the OCA line it grinds diameters and shoulders together with an angled wheelhead.

The Palmary OCA-3265H is the 650 mm (25.6 in) version of Palmary's wide-wheel CNC plunge cylindrical grinder. It swings Ø320 mm (12.6 in), grinds to Ø300 mm (11.8 in) and carries 150 kg (331 lb) between centers.

The Palmary OCA-3295 is the longest CNC angular cylindrical grinder Palmary lists, with 950 mm (37.4 in) between centers. It keeps the Ø320 mm (12.6 in) swing and Ø300 mm (11.8 in) grinding diameter of the series and weighs 8,000 kg (17,637 lb).

The Palmary OCA-3295H has 950 mm (37.4 in) between centers, the longest of the three wide-wheel CNC plunge cylindrical grinders in the OCA-H group. Swing is Ø320 mm (12.6 in) and maximum grinding diameter Ø300 mm (11.8 in).

The Palmary OCD-2020P is the smallest machine in what Palmary calls its CNC plunge grinding series with angular wheelhead. It takes parts up to Ø200 mm (7.9 in) in diameter and just 200 mm (7.9 in) between centers, under a swing of Ø210 mm (8.3 in).

The Palmary OCD-2040 is the smallest machine in the OCD line of CNC cylindrical grinders: Ø220 mm (8.7 in) swing over the table, 400 mm (15.7 in) between centers and a maximum ground diameter of Ø200 mm (7.9 in). Work between centers is limited to 60 kg (132 lb), so this is a machine for small shafts, pins and tooling rather than for heavy rolls.

The Palmary OCD-3220P is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with an angular wheelhead, Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing and a short 200 mm (7.9 in) between centers. Parts up to Ø300 mm (11.8 in) and 150 kg (331 lb) fit, which on a 200 mm length means discs, gears on arbors, flanged bushes and short stub shafts.

The Palmary OCD-3225CAM is a CNC cam grinder: a cylindrical grinder whose work spindle is a controlled C axis, so the wheel can follow a non-round shape as the part turns. It is the shortest of the CAM models, with 250 mm (9.8 in) between centers, Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing and Ø300 mm (11.8 in) of grinding diameter.

The Palmary OCD-3240 is the short-bed member of the OCD-32 family, a CNC cylindrical grinder with Ø320 mm (12.6 in) of swing over the table and 400 mm (15.7 in) between centers. It grinds up to Ø300 mm (11.8 in) and takes 150 kg (331 lb) between No. 4 Morse taper centers.

The Palmary OCD-3240CAM is a CNC cam cylindrical grinder with 400 mm (15.7 in) between centers. It grinds eccentric and non-round profiles up to Ø300 mm (11.8 in) by synchronising the wheel infeed with a C-axis work spindle, and it swings Ø320 mm (12.6 in).

The Palmary OCD-3240P is the 400 mm (15.7 in) model of Palmary's CNC plunge grinders with angular wheelhead, and the one featured in the series video. It swings Ø320 mm (12.6 in) over the table and grinds diameters to Ø300 mm (11.8 in).

With 600 mm (23.6 in) between centers, the Palmary OCD-3260 is the middle length of the OCD-32 CNC cylindrical grinders and the one Palmary pictures on the series page. Swing over the table is Ø320 mm (12.6 in), maximum grinding diameter Ø300 mm (11.8 in), and the centers carry 150 kg (331 lb).

The Palmary OCD-3260CAM extends Palmary's CNC cam cylindrical grinder to 600 mm (23.6 in) between centers. Swing is Ø320 mm (12.6 in), grinding diameter up to Ø300 mm (11.8 in) and load between centers 150 kg (331 lb).

With 800 mm (31.5 in) between centers the Palmary OCD-3280P is the long model of the Ø320 mm (12.6 in) swing plunge grinders with angular wheelhead. It is a CNC machine for stepped shafts with several ground diameters and shoulders along their length.

The Palmary OCD-4220P pairs the biggest swing of the P series, Ø420 mm (16.5 in), with the shortest center distance, 200 mm (7.9 in). It is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with angular wheelhead for large, short, shouldered parts up to Ø400 mm (15.7 in).

The Palmary OCD-4240 puts the largest swing of the standard OCD range, Ø420 mm (16.5 in), on its shortest bed, 400 mm (15.7 in) between centers. That makes it a grinder for discs, flanged hubs, short rolls and chucked parts up to Ø400 mm (15.7 in) rather than for shafts.

The Palmary OCD-4240P is a CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with angular wheelhead offering Ø420 mm (16.5 in) of swing and 400 mm (15.7 in) between centers. Maximum grinding diameter is Ø400 mm (15.7 in), so the envelope is as wide as it is long.

The Palmary OCD-4260 is a CNC cylindrical grinder with Ø420 mm (16.5 in) of swing and 600 mm (23.6 in) between centers, grinding up to Ø400 mm (15.7 in). Among the five OCD-42 lengths it is the second shortest, and the first where the workhead motor grows.

The Palmary OCD-4260CAM is the only large-swing model among Palmary's CNC cam cylindrical grinders: Ø420 mm (16.5 in) over the table, Ø400 mm (15.7 in) of grinding diameter and 600 mm (23.6 in) between centers.

The Palmary OCD-4280P is an 800 mm (31.5 in) CNC plunge cylindrical grinder with angular wheelhead and Ø420 mm (16.5 in) of swing. It handles shafts with large flanges or rotors, up to Ø400 mm (15.7 in), that need several diameters and shoulders ground.

The Palmary OCD-32100 stretches the OCD-32 CNC cylindrical grinder to 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers. Swing stays at Ø320 mm (12.6 in) and the maximum grinding diameter at Ø300 mm (11.8 in), so this is the model for long, fairly slim shafts.

The Palmary OCD-32100CAM is the long model of the Ø320 mm (12.6 in) swing CNC cam cylindrical grinders, with 1,000 mm (39.4 in) between centers. It is meant for full-length camshafts and long shafts carrying eccentric or non-round sections, up to Ø300 mm (11.8 in).

The Palmary OCD-32100E is a special-purpose CNC cylindrical grinder for machine tool spindles. It has the Ø320 mm (12.6 in) swing and 1,000 mm (39.4 in) center distance of the standard OCD-32100 , and almost nothing else in common with it.

The Palmary OCD-42100 is the 1,000 mm (39.4 in) model of the OCD-42 CNC cylindrical grinders and sits in the middle of five bed lengths. It swings Ø420 mm (16.5 in) over the table and grinds diameters up to Ø400 mm (15.7 in).

The Palmary OCD-42130P is the longest of Palmary's CNC plunge cylindrical grinders with angular wheelhead: 1,300 mm (51.2 in) between centers under a Ø420 mm (16.5 in) swing. No smaller-swing P model is as long, so this is the only choice in the series for long stepped shafts.

The Palmary OCD-42150 takes the OCD-42 CNC cylindrical grinder to 1,500 mm (59.1 in) between centers. It keeps the Ø420 mm (16.5 in) swing and Ø400 mm (15.7 in) grinding diameter of the family and adds a larger workhead motor for the longer parts it will see.

At 2,000 mm (78.7 in) between centers the Palmary OCD-42200 is the longest standard OCD CNC cylindrical grinder before Palmary's heavy duty series takes over. Swing is Ø420 mm (16.5 in) and the maximum grinding diameter Ø400 mm (15.7 in).

The Palmary OCD-45150 opens the heavy duty OCD range: a CNC cylindrical grinder with Ø450 mm (17.7 in) of swing, 1,500 mm (59.1 in) between centers and, the figure that defines the series, 800 kg (1,764 lb) between centers. Maximum grinding diameter is Ø420 mm (16.5 in).

The Palmary OCD-45220 is a heavy duty CNC cylindrical grinder with 2,200 mm (86.6 in) between centers and Ø450 mm (17.7 in) of swing. It is the second of four bed lengths in the OCD-45 series, all of which carry 800 kg (1,764 lb) between centers and grind up to Ø420 mm (16.5 in).

Three metres between centers is the headline of the Palmary OCD-45300, a heavy duty CNC cylindrical grinder for long rolls and shafts. The exact figure is 3,000 mm (118.1 in), with Ø450 mm (17.7 in) of swing and Ø420 mm (16.5 in) of grinding diameter.

The Palmary OCD-45400 is the longest OCD-45 heavy duty CNC cylindrical grinder: 4,000 mm (157.5 in) between centers, with a table stroke of 4,620 mm (181.9 in). It is the machine Palmary shows in its heavy duty video.

The Palmary OCD-65150 is the short model of Palmary's largest-swing cylindrical grinders: Ø650 mm (25.6 in) over the table, Ø620 mm (24.4 in) of grinding diameter and 1,500 mm (59.1 in) between centers. It is a CNC machine in the heavy duty OCD series with an 800 kg (1,764 lb) load rating.

The Palmary OCD-65220 combines the Ø650 mm (25.6 in) swing of the OCD-65 heavy duty CNC cylindrical grinders with 2,200 mm (86.6 in) between centers. Maximum grinding diameter is Ø620 mm (24.4 in) and the load between centers 800 kg (1,764 lb).

The Palmary OCD-65300 is a 3,000 mm (118.1 in) heavy duty CNC cylindrical grinder with Ø650 mm (25.6 in) of swing over the table. It grinds diameters up to Ø620 mm (24.4 in) on parts weighing up to 800 kg (1,764 lb) between centers.

The Palmary OCD-65400 is the largest cylindrical grinder in Palmary's catalogue by envelope: Ø650 mm (25.6 in) of swing and 4,000 mm (157.5 in) between centers. It is a heavy duty CNC machine with a table stroke of 4,620 mm (181.9 in).

The Palmary OIG-50 is a compact high-speed CNC internal grinder for very small bores: up to Ø20 mm (0.8 in) in diameter and 40 mm (1.6 in) in length, in parts chucked at up to Ø50 mm (2.0 in). Its grinding wheel spindle runs at 90,000 rpm.
Cooled Parts: Spindle, Linear guideway, Wheel spindle, Dressing spindle
CNC Control: CNC controller with graphical conversational interface (FANUC)

Description: The Palmary OIG-200 is a CNC internal grinder with one wheel spindle, for bores up to Ø150 mm (5.9 in) in parts up to 200 mm (7.9 in) long held in a chuck of up to Ø200 mm (7.9 in). It is the base model of the OIG-200 family.

The Palmary OIG-200D is a CNC internal grinder with two internal wheel spindles and a third linear axis, Y, to carry the second one. It grinds bores up to Ø150 mm (5.9 in) in parts up to 200 mm (7.9 in) long.

The Palmary OIG-200DE is a CNC internal grinder that also carries an external grinding wheel. Palmary describes it as one internal wheel spindle plus one external wheel spindle, for grinding a bore, an end face and an outer diameter in one setting. Bore capacity is Ø150 mm (5.9 in) and workpiece length 200 mm (7.9 in).

The Palmary OIG-200DEL35 combines an internal and an external grinding spindle, like the OIG-200DE , on a CNC machine sized for workpieces up to 350 mm (13.8 in) long. Maximum bore diameter is Ø150 mm (5.9 in).

The Palmary OIG-200DL35 is the long version of Palmary's two-spindle CNC internal grinder. It holds workpieces up to 350 mm (13.8 in) long and grinds bores up to Ø150 mm (5.9 in) with either of two internal wheel spindles.

The Palmary OIG-200L35 is the 350 mm (13.8 in) workpiece-length version of the OIG-200 CNC internal grinder. Bore capacity stays at Ø150 mm (5.9 in) and the chuck at Ø200 mm (7.9 in); what changes is how long a part the machine will hold and turn.

The Palmary OIG-200L50 is the long-bed CNC internal grinder of the OIG-200 family, accepting workpieces up to 500 mm (19.7 in) in length. The bore limit is Ø150 mm (5.9 in) and the chuck limit Ø200 mm (7.9 in), as on the shorter models.

The Palmary PCB-3010 is a 6-axis CNC centerless grinder for small precision parts, with a standard grinding range of Ø0.3 to Ø25 mm. It belongs to the PCB bearing spindle series, in which the grinding wheel spindle runs in rolling bearings and the wheel speed rises to 45 m/s (8,858 ft/min).

The Palmary PCB-3015 is the 150 mm wheel version of Palmary's small 6-axis CNC centerless grinder. It grinds Ø0.3 to Ø25 mm, the same range as the PCB-3010 , with wheels half as wide again and a larger motor.

Description: The Palmary VIG-50 is a CNC vertical grinder with a Ø550 mm (21.7 in) face plate and an automatic wheel changer. It grinds outside diameters from Ø38 to 500 mm, bores, and end faces on parts up to 410 mm (16.1 in) long and 500 kg (1,102 lb).
CNC Control: FANUC CNC controller (included current gap control function)

Description: The Palmary VIG-80 is the mid-size CNC vertical grinder of the VIG range, with a Ø850 mm (33.5 in) face plate and a 1,000 kg (2,205 lb) workpiece load. It grinds outside diameters from Ø65 to 800 mm and parts up to 500 mm (19.7 in) long.
CNC Control: FANUC CNC controller (included current gap control function)

Description: The Palmary VIG-120 is Palmary's largest CNC vertical grinder. Its face plate is Ø1,250 mm (49.2 in), it grinds outside diameters from Ø65 to 1,200 mm, and it carries workpieces of up to 5,000 kg (11,023 lb).
CNC Control: FANUC CNC controller (included current gap control function)

Description: The Palmary VIG-2015 is the smallest CNC vertical grinder Palmary makes. The part sits on a Ø200 mm (7.9 in) chuck with its axis vertical and is ground from above by a built-in internal wheel spindle. Workpieces may be up to 150 mm (5.9 in) long, swing Ø300 mm (11.8 in) and weigh 100 kg (220 lb).
Wheel Spindle Motor: 3.0 kW; Torque : S1 = 1.1 Nm, S6 = 1.5 Nm
CNC Control: FANUC CNC controller (included current gap control function)

Description: The Sharp OD-1320-2X is a 2-axis CNC cylindrical grinder for outside diameters, with a 12.6 in (320 mm) swing over the table and 19.7 in between centers. Sharp lists two sizes of its 2-axis CNC OD grinder, and the OD-1524-2X is the larger: 15 in (381 mm) of swing over the table and 23.6 in (600 mm) between centers.

Description: The Sugino SC-V30aG is a vertical grinding center for brittle materials, built on the frame of the maker's #30 vertical machining center. Sugino names silicon, silicon carbide (SiC) and quartz glass as the work it is for. It keeps a tool changer, here with up to 31 BBT30 tools, and adds a C-axis rotary table that turns at up to 200 min-1 under a 20,000 rpm spindle.

Description: The Supertec G18P-40CNC is the smallest of the maker's CNC plunge-type cylindrical grinders: Ø180 mm (Ø7 in) of swing over the table, 400 mm (16 in) between centers and a work weight limit of 80 kg (176 lb). It is a two-axis machine. The wheelhead infeeds on X and the table traverses on Z, each driven by a 1.2 kW (1.6 hp) servo motor.

At 300 mm (12 in) between centers, the Supertec G20A-30CNC is a very short-bed CNC cylindrical grinder. It is the small angular-type model: Ø200 mm (Ø8 in) of swing, the same figure as its maximum grinding diameter, and 80 kg (176 lb) held between centers.

With Ø200 mm (Ø8 in) of swing and 400 mm (16 in) between centers, the Supertec G20P-40CNC sits in the middle of the maker's three small CNC plunge-type cylindrical grinders. Its wheel is where it parts company with the smaller machine: Ø405 × 50 × Ø127 mm (Ø16 × 2 × Ø5 in), run at 1,800 rpm.

The Supertec G25A-35CNC is an angular-type CNC cylindrical grinder for parts up to Ø250 mm (Ø10 in) in diameter and 350 mm (14 in) between centers. Its Ø455 × 50 × Ø127 mm (Ø18 × 2 × Ø5 in) wheel is large for a machine of this length and runs at 1,650 rpm.

Largest of Supertec's compact CNC plunge grinders, the G25P-50CNC takes work up to Ø250 mm (Ø10 in) in diameter and 500 mm (20 in) between centers. The grinding wheel grows with it, to Ø455 × 50 × Ø127 mm (Ø18 × 2 × Ø5 in), and wheel speed drops to 1,650 rpm to suit the larger diameter.

Description: The Supertec GI-150CNC is a dedicated two-axis internal grinder. The CNC controls the table feed and the wheel infeed and nothing else, which keeps the machine simple next to the maker's three-axis complex grinders. It bores from Ø6~Ø150 mm (Ø0.25~Ø6 in) to a maximum grinding depth of 125 mm (5 in).
Machine Cover: Full Enclosure Splash Guard / Manual Door

Description: The Supertec GM-35CNC is the entry model of the GrindMaster series, a three-axis chucking grinder that works a bore, an outside diameter and a face without releasing the part. The workhead carries the chuck and moves on X. Two wheelheads face it: a combined ID/OD head on the Y axis and a second ID head on the Z axis.
Chuck Size: 6 in Hydraulic Three Claw Chuck (opt. 8 in)

Description: Bores up to Ø400 mm are the headline of the Supertec GM-45CNC: its internal grinding range is Ø6~Ø400 mm (Ø0.2~Ø16 in), twice the upper limit of the smallest GrindMaster. Outside diameters go to Ø450 mm (18 in) and the swing over the table is Ø500 mm (20 in). It is the middle machine of a three-model series of CNC complex grinders that finish bore, OD and faces in one chucking.
Chuck Size: 6 in Hydraulic Three Claw Chuck (opt. 8 in)

Description: Only one GrindMaster has a programmable B axis, and it is the Supertec GM-80CNC. The table lists the wheelhead swivel as automatic servo rotation, driven by a 1.2 kW (1.6 hp) motor through +120° / -30°. On the two smaller models that row is marked not available. With it, the control can turn the wheelhead between operations, presenting the OD wheel or an ID wheel at the angle a taper or face calls for.
Chuck Size: 8 in Hydraulic Three Claw Chuck (opt. 10 in)

Description: The Supertec PL-2448CNC is a column-type CNC surface grinder with a 600 × 1,200 mm (24 × 48 in) table rated for 1,700 kg (3,748 lb). On a column machine the wheelhead, not the table saddle, makes the cross movement, so the table stays fully supported under heavy plates and mould bases.

Long plates are the job of the Supertec PL-2460CNC. Its 600 × 1,500 mm (24 × 60 in) table and 1,500 mm (60 in) of X travel put it at the top of the maker's column-type CNC surface grinders, and the table is rated for 2,000 kg (4,409 lb).

The Supertec PL-2550CNC is a saddle-type CNC surface grinder with a 250 × 500 mm (9.8 × 19.7 in) table, the smaller of two models in the maker's high-precision saddle range. Vertical and cross axes run on linear guide ways with ball screws, each driven by an 800W AC servo motor, and the control is a SIEMENS 828D or FANUC Series 0i-MF.

Description: The Supertec TPL-2448CNC is a CNC grinder built for one product: gear racks. Supertec sells it in the STMantα series as a gear rack specialized grinder, the shortest of three, with a 600 × 1,200 mm (24 × 48 in) table. The frame is that of a column-type surface grinder. What changes is how the axes are used, since a rack tooth is formed by stepping a profiled wheel along the blank one pitch at a time.

Mid-length racks, around a metre and a half, are the territory of the Supertec TPL-2460CNC. It is the middle model of the maker's three CNC gear rack grinders, with a 600 × 1,500 mm (24 × 60 in) table and 1,550 mm (60 in) of X axis travel.

Two-metre racks in one piece: that is what the Supertec TPL-2480CNC adds to the maker's gear rack grinder line. The table is 600 × 2,000 mm (24 × 80 in) and the X axis travels 2,050 mm (80 in), the longest of the three TPL-CNC models.

Description: The Thielenhaus BearingStar 90 finishes the raceways of ball and roller bearing rings with outer ring outside diameters of 26 – 90 mm (1.0 – 3.5 in) and inner ring inside diameters of 10 – 50 mm (0.39 – 2.0 in). Ring width is 8 – 35 mm (0.31 – 1.4 in). It is a fully automatic Microfinish machine, built with 1 or 2 machining stations.

The Thielenhaus BearingStar 120 is the larger of the two machines on Thielenhaus's shared BS 90 / BS 120 data sheet. It takes outer rings of 60 – 120 mm (2.4 – 4.7 in) outside diameter, inner rings of 30 – 80 mm (1.2 – 3.1 in) inside diameter and ring widths of 12 – 40 mm (0.47 – 1.6 in).

The Thielenhaus BearingStar 200 is the mid-size machine of the BearingStar range, for outer rings of 85 – 200 mm (3.3 – 7.9 in) outside diameter and inner rings of 50 – 180 mm (2.0 – 7.1 in) inner diameter. Ring width runs from 15 – 80 mm (0.59 – 3.1 in). Thielenhaus builds it with 1 or 2 machining stations as a fully automatic Microfinish machine for ball and roller bearing inner and outer rings.

The Thielenhaus BearingStar 320 handles outer rings of 180 – 320 mm (7.1 – 12.6 in) outside diameter and inner rings of 100 – 270 mm (3.9 – 10.6 in) inner diameter, with ring widths of 20 – 200 mm (0.79 – 7.9 in). The width range is the figure to notice. A ring 200 mm wide is a long raceway for one stone to cover, and the machine does it on a single machining station.

The Thielenhaus BearingStar 650 is the largest ring machine in the BearingStar range. Outer rings run from 200 – 650 mm (7.9 – 25.6 in) outside diameter, inner rings from 180 – 580 mm (7.1 – 22.8 in) inner diameter, and ring width from 20 – 300 mm (0.79 – 11.8 in). It has 1 machining station.

The Thielenhaus BearingStar mini is the smallest machine in the BearingStar range: a fully automatic Microfinish machine for the raceways of miniature ball and roller bearing rings. It takes workpieces of 5 – 19 mm (0.20 – 0.75 in) in diameter and 2.5 – 15 mm (0.10 – 0.59 in) in width on a single machining station, and it works by the 1-step method.

It is a fully automatic Microfinish machine with 2 machining stations for 1- or 2-step raceway finishing.

Description: The Vollmer CM 200 grinds the complete tooth geometry of TCT circular saw blades for metal cutting, tops and faces, on blades from 200 to 840 mm (7.9 to 33.1 in) in outer diameter. It is a production grinder for blade manufacturers, with 9 CNC axes and a weight of approx. 4,700 kg (10,362 lb).
Spindle 1 Wheel: 125 mm (4.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore
Spindle 2 Wheel: 80 to 200 mm (3.1 to 7.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore

Description: The Vollmer CM 300 is the large-diameter version of Vollmer's top and face grinder for TCT metal-cutting circular saw blades. It takes blades from 200 to 1,440 mm (7.9 to 56.7 in) in outer diameter. Everything about the grinding end matches the CM 200 , which stops at 840 mm (33.1 in); what changes is the reach of the blade carriage, the weight and the connected load.
Spindle 1 Wheel: 125 mm (4.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore
Spindle 2 Wheel: 80 to 200 mm (3.1 to 7.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore

Description: The Vollmer CMF 200 grinds the tooth sides of TCT circular saw blades for metal cutting. It works with a cup grinding wheel, so the flanks come out flat instead of slightly hollow, and it measures the tooth before it grinds. Blade diameters run from 200 to 840 mm (7.9 to 33.1 in).
Wheel Size: 100 to 125 mm (3.9 to 4.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore

Description: The Vollmer CMF 300 is a side grinder for large TCT circular saw blades, covering outer diameters from 200 to 1,440 mm (7.9 to 56.7 in). Like the smaller CMF 200 it grinds the flanks with a cup wheel and has 9 CNC axes. It is the flank partner to the CM 300 top and face grinder, which shares the 1,440 mm (56.7 in) limit.
Wheel Size: 100 to 125 mm (3.9 to 4.9 in) outer diameter, 32 mm (1.3 in) bore

Description: The Vollmer CP 650 is the smallest of Vollmer's CNC machines for sharpening tooth faces and tooth tops on carbide-tipped circular saw blades. It takes blades from 80 to 650 mm (3.1 to 25.6 in) and weighs approx. 900 kg (1,984 lb), about half of what the CHC 840 / CHC 1300 weighs in its smaller frame at approx. 1,660 kg (3,660 lb).

It is the companion to the CP 650 , built into the same compact enclosure at approx. 900 kg (1,984 lb), and it brings five-axis CNC side grinding to shops whose blades are small.

Description: Bent tube, hydroformed sections, extrusions and stamped sheet are the work of the BLM Group LT-FREE, an enclosed 5-axis fiber laser cell for parts that are already three-dimensional when they reach the laser. The BLM Group LT12 takes the Lasertube range into structural sizes. It processes tube up to 12" in diameter, which BLM also gives as 305 mm, and profiles up to 41.6 lb/ft, using a Tube Cutter 3D head and a fiber source of 3, 4 or 5 kW.

A 350 mm (13.8 in) chuck makes the Dener E-FTL 6035 the largest-capacity machine among the 7,000 mm E-FTL tube lasers. It accepts laser sources from 3 to 12 kW and bars up to 600 kg (1,323 lb).

The Dener E-FTL 9025 is a long-bed tube fiber laser: 9,300 mm (366.1 in) of maximum cutting length with a 250 mm chuck. It extends the E-FTL 6025 for stock that arrives in lengths beyond seven metres.

Top of the two-chuck series, the Dener E-FTL 9035 combines the 350 mm (13.8 in) chuck with a 9,300 mm cutting length. Its maximum cutting weight is 1,200 kg (2,646 lb), by a wide margin the highest of any E-FTL.
The Dener FTL 6018 opens Dener's three-chuck tube fiber laser series. It holds tube in a 180 mm (7.1 in) chuck, cuts lengths up to 6,200 mm and is offered with laser power from 3 to 20 kW.

The Dener FTL 6025 is a three-chuck tube fiber laser with a 250 mm (9.8 in) chuck and a 6,200 mm cutting length. In Dener's FTL table it sits between the FTL 6018 and the FTL 6035 on the same 16,100 mm frame.

Largest chuck of the six-metre group, the Dener FTL 6035 is a three-chuck tube fiber laser for sections up to 350 mm (13.8 in). Cutting length is 6,200 mm and the maximum cutting weight 600 kg (1,323 lb).
The Dener FTL 9025 is a nine-metre, three-chuck tube fiber laser. Maximum cutting length is 9,300 mm (366.1 in) with a 250 mm chuck, and both loading and unloading lengths are 9 m.

A 350 mm (13.8 in) chuck on the nine-metre frame gives the Dener FTL 9035 the widest section range of Dener's mid-length tube lasers. Maximum cutting length is 9,300 mm and maximum cutting weight 1,200 kg (2,646 lb).

Twelve metres is the standard mill length for much structural tube, and the Dener FTL 12025 is the smallest Dener tube fiber laser that takes it whole. Maximum cutting length is 12,300 mm (484.3 in), the chuck is 250 mm and the loading and unloading lengths are 12 m each.
The Dener FTL 12035 is a twelve-metre tube fiber laser with a 350 mm (13.8 in) chuck, and the first model in the range whose power band starts higher: laser power is listed as 6-20 kW.

The Dener FTL 12064 is the largest tube fiber laser Dener lists. Its chuck is 640 mm (25.2 in), nearly twice the next size down, and a single bar may weigh 2,600 kg (5,732 lb) at a cutting length of up to 12,300 mm.

The Dener Pro DC 3015 is the smallest table size of Dener's Pro DC fiber laser cutting machines, a gantry-type flatbed laser with an automatic pallet changer. Dener offers the Pro DC series with laser power from 3 kW to 20 kW and builds it in 3015, 4020, 6020 and 8025 table sizes.

Between the compact and the long tables of Dener's fiber laser range sits the Dener Pro DC 4020. It is a flatbed fiber laser cutting machine on the 4020 table size, with two exchange pallets and a choice of resonators from 3 kW to 20 kW.

The Dener Pro DC 6020 is the longest Pro DC fiber laser for which Dener publishes a specification table. It belongs to the 6020 table size and is aimed at long sheets and at nests that fill a large pallet.

Description: The DMG MORI LASERTEC 100 PowerDrill is a 5-axis laser drilling machine for large turbine components: DMG MORI states a component diameter of up to 1,100 mm and a maximum height of 1,500 mm. Y and Z travel are each 1,000 mm (39.4 in). The work it is built for is cooling air holes in aerospace and IGT (industrial gas turbine) parts.

The Durma HD-F 3015 VI is a flat-bed fiber laser cutting machine for 3,048 x 1,524 mm (120.0 x 60.0 in) sheet, and the fastest of Durma's rack-and-pinion lasers. Its axes travel 3,100 mm (122.0 in) in X, 1,525 mm (60.0 in) in Y and 160 mm (6.3 in) in Z. Each of X and Y reaches 120 m/min, and with both moving together the head runs at 170 m/min with 28 m/s² of synchronized acceleration.

Unlike Durma's flat-bed lasers, the HD-FA is a 5 axis fiber laser for cutting formed, three-dimensional parts. The head moves 3,000 mm (118.1 in) in X, 1,500 mm (59.1 in) in Y and 650 mm (25.6 in) in Z, and tilts and turns on two rotary axes: B through ±135° and C through ±360° x n, meaning continuous rotation.

Durma positions the HD-FN 3015 as the plainer of its flat-bed fiber lasers: a 3,048 x 1,524 mm (120.0 x 60.0 in) machine with laser power up to 20 kW and moderate axis dynamics. X travel is 3,100 mm (122.0 in) and Y travel 1,525 mm (60.0 in). The Z axis is printed as 125 (270) mm, without an explanation of the bracketed figure.

Description: The Durma HD-FO is a compact fiber laser cutting machine built for shops that are short of floor space. It cuts 3,048 x 1,524 mm (120.0 x 60.0 in) sheet, but it is laid out differently from Durma's other flat-bed lasers: the laser source and the chiller sit inside the machine, and the standard machine has a manual cutting table instead of a shuttle table.

Small tube at high rotation speed is the purpose of the Durma HD-TC 60170, the lightest of the bundle-loading HD-TC tube lasers. Its largest round is Ø170 mm (6.7 in), its largest square 120 x 120 mm (4.7 x 4.7 in) and its largest rectangle 150 x 100 mm (5.9 x 3.9 in). Material up to 6,500 mm (255.9 in) long is taken from a bundle of up to 3,000 kg (6,614 lb).

The Durma HD-TC 60220 is the centre of the HD-TC tube and profile laser range: Ø220 mm (8.7 in) round tube, 160 x 160 mm (6.3 x 6.3 in) square and 200 x 100 mm (7.9 x 3.9 in) rectangular profile, cut from lengths up to 6,500 mm (255.9 in). It is the machine Durma uses to present the series in its brochure.

The Durma HD-TC 60250 COMPACT is the short-footprint member of the HD-TC tube and profile laser family. It cuts round tube from Ø16 mm (0.6 in) to Ø250 mm (9.8 in), square profile up to 160 x 160 mm (6.3 x 6.3 in) and rectangular profile up to 200 x 150 mm (7.9 x 5.9 in), in lengths up to 6,000 mm (236.2 in).

Description: The Durma HD-TC 60350 MEGA opens the heavy end of the HD-TC tube laser range. Its chucks take round tube up to Ø350 mm (13.8 in) and square or rectangular profile up to 350 x 350 mm (13.8 x 13.8 in), in material up to 6,500 mm (255.9 in) long. Compared with the HD-TC 60220 , section weight more than doubles: 125 kg/m and 800 kg (1,764 lb) per workpiece.

Stock longer than the usual six metres is the reason for the Durma HD-TC 80220. This tube and profile laser accepts material up to 8,500 mm (334.6 in) long, with the section capacity of the HD-TC 60220 : Ø220 mm (8.7 in) round, 160 x 160 mm (6.3 x 6.3 in) square and 200 x 100 mm (7.9 x 3.9 in) rectangular.

Twelve-metre structural sections go through the Durma HD-TC 120350 MEGA in one piece. This tube and profile laser takes material up to 12,500 mm (492.1 in) long and unloads finished parts up to 12,000 mm (472.4 in), in round tube to Ø350 mm (13.8 in) and square or rectangular profile to 350 x 350 mm (13.8 x 13.8 in).
