Description: The YCM GT-200B is the smallest two-axis turning center in the GT series: an 8" chuck on an A2-6 spindle nose, a maximum turning diameter of ø260 mm (ø10.24 in) and a turning length of 345 mm (13.58 in). The spindle runs to 4,500 rpm and the turret is a 10-station servo unit with hydraulic clamping.

Live tools are what the YCM GT-200MA adds to the small GT lathe. It has a 12-station radial power turret, a 6" chuck on an A2-5 nose and a 6,000 rpm main spindle, for turned parts up to ø230 mm (ø9.06 in) in diameter and 370 mm (14.57 in) long.

The YCM GT-250B is a 10" chuck turning center for mid-size shaft and flange work: ø350 mm (ø13.78 in) maximum turning diameter, 515 mm (20.28 in) between the chuck and the end of the cut, and a 3,500 rpm spindle on an A2-8 nose.

In the YCM GT-250MA the mid-size GT lathe gets a 12-station radial power turret and trades chuck size for reach. It carries an 8" chuck on an A2-6 nose, spins at 4,500 rpm, and turns parts up to ø270 mm (ø10.63 in) in diameter and 560 mm (22.05 in) in length.

The YCM GT-300B is the big-bore two-axis lathe of the GT series. Its spindle has a ø105 mm (ø4.13 in) through hole and a ø91 mm (ø3.58 in) draw bar hole, and it turns parts up to ø440 mm (ø17.32 in) in diameter and 700 mm (27.56 in) long at up to 3,000 rpm.

Long bed, big bore, live tools: the YCM GT-300LMB combines the three. Its maximum turning length is 1,233 mm (48.54 in) on a Z travel of 1,283 mm (50.51 in), the spindle has a ø105 mm (ø4.13 in) through hole, and the 12-station radial power turret drives tools at 3,000 rpm.
Turret Type: Radial Power Turret (Servo Rotation, Hydraulic Clamping)

Description: The YCM GT-300MA is a live-tool turning center on the GT-300 bed, with a 12-station radial power turret that is servo rotated and hydraulically clamped. It turns up to ø360 mm (ø14.17 in) in diameter and 742 mm (29.21 in) in length, with a spindle speed of 3,500 rpm.
Turret Type: Radial Power Turret (Servo Rotation, Hydraulic Clamping)

Description: The YCM NT-2500SY is a twin-spindle turning center with a Y axis, built to finish a part on both ends without an operator turning it round. The main spindle has an A2-8 nose and runs to 3,500 rpm; the sub-spindle has an A2-5 nose and runs to 6,000 rpm. Maximum turning diameter is ø350 mm (ø13.78 in) and turning length 686 mm (27.01 in).

Sub-spindle plus Y axis on a fast 8" lathe: that is the YCM NTC-2000LSY. The main spindle turns 5,000 rpm on an A2-6 nose, the sub-spindle 6,000 rpm on an A2-5 nose with a 6" chuck, and one 12-station BMT55 power turret works on both.
Turret Type: Radial Power Turret (Servo Rotation, Hydraulic Clamping)

Description: The YCM NTC-2000LY is a Y-axis turning center with an 8" chuck, a 5,000 rpm spindle and a BMT55 live-tool turret. It turns parts up to ø320 mm (ø12.6 in) in diameter and 570 mm (22.44 in) in length, and its Y axis is listed as 90 mm, split 50 above and 40 below centre.
Turret Type: Radial Power Turret (Servo Rotation, Hydraulic Clamping)

Description: The YCM TC-16LA is a light, fast two-axis turning center on linear guideways. It has a 6" chuck on an A2-5 nose, a 5,000 rpm spindle, and turns parts up to ø260 mm (ø10.24 in) in diameter and 600 mm (23.62 in) in length.

Give the TC-16L bed a bigger spindle and you have the YCM TC-16LB. This two-axis turning center mounts an 8" chuck on an A2-6 nose, with a ø77 mm (ø3.03 in) spindle bore and a ø66 mm (ø2.6 in) hole through the draw bar. Top speed is 4,500 rpm.

A long-bed, geared-head lathe for big shafts, the YCM TC-36 turns up to ø590 mm (ø23.23 in) in diameter and 1,189 mm (46.81 in) in length. Z travel is 1,250 mm (49.21 in) and the main motor is rated 22/26 kW (30/35 HP).

Turret Type: Radial Power Turret (Servo Rotation, Hydraulic Clamping)

Description: The You Ji AH06 is the fastest of three heavy-duty horizontal turning lathes that share one bed, one Ø950 mm (37.4 in) swing and one 37/45 kW (49.6/60.3 hp) spindle motor. What sets it apart is the spindle: an A2-15 nose with Ø153 mm (6.0 in) of bar capacity, a Ø690 mm (27.2 in) hydraulic chuck in the table, and a top gear that reaches 1,200 rpm.
Max Turning Diameter: Ø900 mm (35.4 in); Ø800 mm (31.5 in) on M models

Description: Ø232 mm (9.1 in) manual / Ø205 mm (8.1 in) hydraulic
Max Turning Diameter: Ø900 mm (35.4 in); Ø800 mm (31.5 in) on M models
Bar Capacity: Ø232 mm (9.1 in) manual / Ø205 mm (8.1 in) hydraulic

Description: With Ø306 mm (12.0 in) of bar capacity and an A2-20 spindle nose, the You Ji AH12 is the largest-bore machine in the AH family of heavy-duty horizontal turning lathes. Casing, large-diameter line pipe and hollow rolls go through the headstock so that only the end being machined sits in the work zone.
Max Turning Diameter: Ø900 mm (35.4 in); Ø800 mm (31.5 in) on M models

Description: The You Ji CY550H is a CNC vertical turning lathe designed around its pallet changer. The base machine has a 15 in (381 mm) chuck and a horizontal turret (the H in the name); the CY550H-APC adds an automatic pallet changer, which You Ji describes as a high efficiency APC system for workpiece loading and unloading.

The You Ji HV320 combines two lathes in one machine: a CNC vertical turning lathe and an inverted spindle lathe. The catalogue table has one column for each, the inverted spindle labelled OP1 and the vertical turning lathe OP2, so a part is turned on one side, handed over and finished on the other without leaving the enclosure.

The You Ji TY400H is a narrow-bodied CNC vertical turning lathe with a 10 in (254 mm) chuck and a horizontal turret. The frame is built front to back: the floor dimension is 1,030 x 3,200 mm (40.6 x 126.0 in), so several machines can stand side by side with little width per spindle.

A 12 in (305 mm) chuck, Ø450 mm (17.7 in) of turning diameter and an equal 450 mm (17.7 in) of turning height: the You Ji TY600H is the larger of the two TY vertical turning lathes. The series is laid out deep and narrow, and this model measures 1,300 x 3,800 mm (51.2 x 149.6 in) on the floor.

The You Ji VHL1200ATC is a CNC vertical turning center with a side head: a second tool carrier mounted on the column that works on the outside of the part while the main ram works from above. The table is Ø1,250 mm (49.2 in) and the maximum turning diameter Ø1,350 mm (53.1 in).

On the You Ji VHL1600ATC a side head works alongside the main ram of a Ø1,600 mm (63.0 in) vertical turning center. The machine turns Ø1,800 mm (70.9 in), swings Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) and takes parts 1,200 mm (47.2 in) high.

Every drive and travel row is larger on the You Ji VHL2000ATC than on the two smaller side-head machines. This vertical turning center has a Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) table, a 60/75 kW (80.5/100.6 hp) table motor and an 11/15 kW (14.8/20.1 hp) live spindle motor on the side head.

The You Ji VTH3000ATC is a heavy-duty vertical turning lathe whose Ø3,000 mm (118.1 in) table runs on a hydrostatic bearing. That bearing is the point of the VTH series: the table floats on a pressurised oil film, and the rated load is 45,000 kg (99,206 lb).

Take the VTH3000ATC , widen the table to Ø3,500 mm (137.8 in), and the result is the You Ji VTH3500ATC. It is a hydrostatic-table vertical turning lathe that turns Ø3,800 mm (149.6 in) and swings Ø4,100 mm (161.4 in).

Sixty tonnes on a four-metre table: the You Ji VTH4000ATC is rated for a 60,000 kg (132,275 lb) loading weight and driven by a 100/140 kW (134.1/187.7 hp) spindle motor. It is a CNC vertical turning lathe with a hydrostatic table bearing, Ø4,000 mm (157.5 in) across.

The You Ji VTH4500ATC is the largest VTH vertical turning lathe driven by a single motor. From the VTH5000ATC upward the catalogue lists the spindle motor twice over; here it is one 100/140 kW (134.1/187.7 hp) unit turning a Ø4,500 mm (177.2 in) hydrostatic table.

The You Ji VTH5000ATC begins the very large half of the VTH range. This hydrostatic-table vertical turning lathe has a Ø5,000 mm (196.9 in) table, carries 100,000 kg (220,459 lb) and lists its spindle motor as 2 x 60/84 kW (2 x 80.5/112.6 hp).

A Ø6,000 mm (236.2 in) table rated for 150,000 kg (330,688 lb) is what the You Ji VTH6000ATC offers. The machine is a hydrostatic-bearing CNC vertical turning lathe that turns up to Ø6,900 mm (271.7 in) inside a Ø7,400 mm (291.3 in) swing.

Quarter of a million kilograms: the You Ji VTH7000ATC has a maximum loading weight of 250,000 kg (551,146 lb). Its hydrostatic table is Ø7,000 mm (275.6 in) across, and the machine turns Ø8,500 mm (334.6 in) within a Ø9,000 mm (354.3 in) swing.

You Ji's biggest vertical turning lathe is the VTH8000ATC. The hydrostatic table measures Ø8,000 mm (315.0 in), the maximum turning diameter is Ø8,900 mm (350.4 in) and the maximum loading weight is 300,000 kg (661,376 lb).

The You Ji VTL1200ATC is a CNC vertical turning lathe with an automatic tool changer, a Ø1,250 mm (49.2 in) table and a maximum turning diameter of Ø1,350 mm (53.1 in). It is the entry point to the VTL series on You Ji's current list, a family the maker describes as a symmetric design for column and base.

Two rams become possible at the You Ji VTL1600ATC. You Ji's model key offers the double ram (2R) version from the 1600 upward, which makes this the smallest VTL vertical turning lathe that can cut with two heads at once or keep a turning ram and a milling ram set up side by side.

The You Ji VTL2000ATC is the size at which the VTL series gets a bigger drive: a 60/75 kW (80.5/100.6 hp) spindle motor in place of the 37/45 kW (49.6/60.3 hp) unit of the VTL1600ATC . It is a CNC vertical turning lathe with a Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) table, an automatic tool changer and a BT-50 tool shank.

For shops that want a pallet changer on the biggest possible table, the You Ji VTL2500ATC is the limit. You Ji lists the automatic pallet changer for VTL sizes 1000 to 2500, and this CNC vertical turning lathe sits at the top of that span with a Ø2,500 mm (98.4 in) table.

At three metres of table, the You Ji VTL3000ATC is a different class of installation from the smaller VTL vertical turning lathes. The catalogue lists a floor dimension of 11,000 x 7,000 mm (433.1 x 275.6 in) and a height of 7,400 mm (291.3 in).

The You Ji VTL3500ATC stretches the VTL vertical turning lathe to a Ø3,500 mm (137.8 in) table while keeping the drive and load rating of the size below it. Maximum turning diameter is Ø3,800 mm (149.6 in) and the swing Ø4,100 mm (161.4 in).

100 kW (134.1 hp) is the spindle motor rating of the You Ji VTL4000ATC, the first VTL vertical turning lathe with a three-figure motor rating. The table is Ø4,000 mm (157.5 in), the turning diameter Ø4,300 mm (169.3 in) and the swing Ø4,600 mm (181.1 in).
The largest machine in You Ji's VTL table is the VTL4500ATC, a CNC vertical turning lathe with a Ø4,500 mm (177.2 in) table. It turns Ø4,800 mm (189.0 in) and swings Ø5,100 mm (200.8 in).

The You Ji VTS1000ATC is a fixed cross-rail vertical turning lathe with a Ø1,000 mm (39.4 in) table, an automatic tool changer and Capto C6 tooling. It opens the VTS series, which You Ji defines by that fixed type cross-rail: the rail does not travel up and down the columns, so the ram works from one rigid height.

Ø1,400 mm (55.1 in) of turning diameter on a Ø1,250 mm (49.2 in) table: the You Ji VTS1200ATC turns slightly wider than You Ji's other machines of this table size. It is the second model of the VTS family of vertical turning lathes, built with a fixed type cross-rail and an automatic tool changer.

The You Ji VTS1600ATC is a fixed cross-rail vertical turning lathe for discs and rings up to Ø1,800 mm (70.9 in). Its table is Ø1,600 mm (63.0 in), the swing Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) and the loading weight 8,000 kg (17,637 lb).

A two-metre table under a fixed cross-rail: the You Ji VTS2000ATC is a CNC vertical turning lathe with a Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) table, a 60/75 kW (80.5/100.6 hp) spindle motor and a Capto C6 automatic tool changer.

The You Ji VTS2500ATC carries 15,000 kg (33,069 lb) on a Ø2,500 mm (98.4 in) table and turns up to Ø2,800 mm (110.2 in). It is a fixed cross-rail vertical turning lathe with an automatic tool changer and the Capto C6 tool shank common to the VTS series.

With the You Ji VTS3000ATC the fixed cross-rail is set higher: maximum turning height is 1,000 mm (39.4 in), up from the 800 mm (31.5 in) of the VTS2500ATC and every smaller VTS model. The table is Ø3,000 mm (118.1 in).

The top of the VTS range, the You Ji VTS4000ATC, puts a Ø4,000 mm (157.5 in) table under a fixed cross-rail and drives it with a 100 kW (134.1 hp) motor. Maximum turning diameter is Ø4,500 mm (177.2 in) and the swing Ø4,800 mm (189.0 in).

Description: The You Ji YH15 is a compact CNC horizontal turning lathe with a 6 in (152 mm) chuck, an A2-5 spindle nose and an 8-st. turret. It is the smallest machine in the YH series and the only one with a chuck this small.

An 8 in (203 mm) chuck, an A2-6 spindle nose and Ø52 mm (2.0 in) of bar capacity put the You Ji YH21 in the most common size class of CNC horizontal turning lathes. Maximum turning diameter is Ø416 mm (16.4 in) under a Ø560 mm (22.0 in) swing.

The You Ji YH28 is a 10 in (254 mm) chuck CNC horizontal turning lathe offered in two bed lengths. The catalogue gives the maximum turning length as 550/1,050 mm (21.7/41.3 in), so the same headstock and turret serve either a chucker or a short-shaft machine.

Four bed lengths are listed for the You Ji YH36, a 15 in (381 mm) chuck CNC horizontal turning lathe: the maximum turning length is given as 750/1,350/2,000/3,000 mm (29.5/53.1/78.7/118.1 in). The catalogue pictures the machine as YH36/200 and YH36+C/200, the suffix naming the length.

The You Ji YV200 is the smallest machine in the YV range of CNC vertical turning lathes: an 8 in (203 mm) chuck, a maximum turning diameter of Ø250 mm (9.8 in) and 200 mm (7.9 in) of turning height. It is a chucker for small discs, hubs, flanges and bearing-size rings that sit flat on a vertical spindle and load by gravity.

With a 10 in (254 mm) chuck and Ø350 mm (13.8 in) of turning diameter, the You Ji YV250 is the second size in the YV family of CNC vertical turning lathes. Turning height is 250 mm (9.8 in) and the swing is Ø500 mm (19.7 in).

The You Ji YV500 is a 15 in (381 mm) chuck vertical turning lathe that turns up to Ø550 mm (21.7 in) in diameter and 500 mm (19.7 in) in height. It is the size at which the YV range changes character: the table load jumps to 1,200 kg (2,646 lb) and the tooling list opens up to include an automatic tool changer.

An 18 in (457 mm) chuck defines the You Ji YV550. This vertical turning lathe turns Ø650 mm (25.6 in) by 500 mm (19.7 in) high, swings Ø800 mm (31.5 in) and carries 1,200 kg (2,646 lb) on the spindle.
The You Ji YV600 moves the YV vertical turning lathe onto a 24 in (610 mm) chuck. Maximum turning diameter is Ø750 mm (29.5 in), turning height 600 mm (23.6 in) and swing Ø850 mm (33.5 in).

Ø800 mm (31.5 in) is the figure to remember for the You Ji YV700. That is the maximum turning diameter of this CNC vertical turning lathe, held in a 24 in (610 mm) chuck with Ø900 mm (35.4 in) of swing and 600 mm (23.6 in) of turning height.

The You Ji YV1000 is where the YV line stops being a chucker and becomes a table-type vertical turning lathe. The catalogue quotes its chuck as Ø1,000 mm (39.4 in), the maximum turning diameter as Ø1,100 mm (43.3 in) and the turning height as 900 mm (35.4 in).

Turning height is the reason to look at the You Ji YV1200. At 1,200 mm (47.2 in) it clears parts a third taller than the YV1000 can take, on a table quoted at Ø1,250 mm (49.2 in) with a maximum turning diameter of Ø1,350 mm (53.1 in).

The You Ji YV1600 tops the YV range: a vertical turning lathe with a Ø1,600 mm (63.0 in) table, Ø1,800 mm (70.9 in) maximum turning diameter and Ø2,000 mm (78.7 in) swing. Workpieces up to 1,200 mm (47.2 in) high and 8,000 kg (17,637 lb) are within its table figures.
